name: @async-browser-context/async-browser-context
description: Automatic async context propagation for browsers with perfect concurrent isolation - zero code changes required

scripts.test:build: bash -c 'for file in tests/suites/**/*.test.js; do [ -f "$file" ] && babel "$file" --out-file "${file%.test.js}-transformed.js" || true; done && babel tests/suites/01-core/core-tests.js --out-file tests/suites/01-core/core-tests-transformed.js'
scripts.test: npm run test:build && npm run test:serve
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build
